title: Tackling Online Abuse: A Survey of Automated Abuse Detection Methods
benchmark_measurement: Detection of abuse targeting religious groups. Specifically, one of the surveyed datasets included a fine-grained hierarchical taxonomy which covered targets of abuse, including religion.
findings: The paper does not present original findings on religion, but as a survey, it notes that religion is a documented target category for online abuse in existing datasets. It also uses a tweet mentioning 'Islam' as an example to illustrate how detecting abuse can be challenging and context-dependent, especially when explicit abusive keywords are absent.
